## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

**1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?**
RISK-ON — Breadth: 9/11 sectors positive; confirmers: sector breadth ≥7/11 and cyclicals leading (Materials, Industrials, Financials). Leadership concentrated and narrow: Top 5 performers include 4 Technology names (Leadership: Narrow, 4/5 Technology).

**2. Which sectors are leading?**
Materials lead: CRH (1W: +12.67% | 1M: +13.36%) ABOVE TREND, FCX (1W: +10.46% | 1M: +10.17%) ABOVE TREND. Industrials strong: ETN (1W: +11.60% | 1M: +13.27%) ABOVE TREND, CAT (1W: +10.24% | 1M: +11.74%) ABOVE TREND. Financials strong: JPM (1W: +5.72% | 1M: +8.32%) ABOVE TREND.

**3. Which sectors are lagging?**
Energy weak: XOM (1W: -5.09% | 1M: +0.61%) CORRECTION, PSX (1W: -9.62% | 1M: -6.05%) BELOW TREND. Communication weak: sector negative with NFLX sentiment but many names lag; example: META (1W: +9.64% | 1M: -3.74%) RECOVERY.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

**4. Top Performing Stocks?**
Top 5: INTC (1W: +23.82% | 1M: +30.01%) ABOVE TREND, LRCX (1W: +20.70% | 1M: +20.46%) ABOVE TREND, AVGO (1W: +18.12% | 1M: +9.01%) ABOVE TREND, AMAT (1W: +14.64% | 1M: +13.79%) ABOVE TREND, AMZN (1W: +13.64% | 1M: +12.10%) ABOVE TREND — Leadership: Narrow (4/5 Technology).

**5. Worst Performing Stocks?**
Bottom 5: IBM (1W: -7.01% | 1M: -7.28%) BELOW TREND, ADBE (1W: -7.23% | 1M: -17.67%) BELOW TREND, MPC (1W: -7.91% | 1M: -1.82%) BELOW TREND, OXY (1W: -7.94% | 1M: +4.30%) CORRECTION, PSX (1W: -9.62% | 1M: -6.05%) BELOW TREND — weakness concentrated in select Tech and Energy names.

**6. Momentum Stocks?**
Best 1W momentum: INTC (1W: +23.82% | 1M: +30.01%) ABOVE TREND, LRCX (1W: +20.70% | 1M: +20.46%) ABOVE TREND, AVGO (1W: +18.12% | 1M: +9.01%) ABOVE TREND; note MAJOR divergence with multiple large-cap names in RECOVERY (AAPL, META, V, MA, LLY) — tactical watch, not unconditional re-risk.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

**7. Technology Outlook?**
Mixed but leadership concentrated: NVDA (1W: +6.34% | 1M: +1.40%) ABOVE TREND, INTC (1W: +23.82% | 1M: +30.01%) ABOVE TREND, AMD (1W: +12.66% | 1M: +19.63%) ABOVE TREND while ADBE (1W: -7.23% | 1M: -17.67%) BELOW TREND, MSFT (1W: -0.69% | 1M: -8.40%) BELOW TREND; Sector breadth: Technology: 15/24 positive.

**8. Financials Outlook?**
Constructive and broad: JPM (1W: +5.72% | 1M: +8.32%) ABOVE TREND, GS (not listed in detail) showing sector strength, V (1W: +1.18% | 1M: -1.49%) RECOVERY, MA (1W: +1.23% | 1M: -0.89%) RECOVERY; Sector breadth: Financials: 14/20 positive.

**9. Healthcare Outlook?**
Mixed defensive elements but not dominant: UNH (1W: +9.76% | 1M: +6.69%) ABOVE TREND, LLY (1W: +0.42% | 1M: -6.04%) RECOVERY, JNJ (1W: -1.88% | 1M: -1.86%) BELOW TREND; Sector breadth: Healthcare: 9/17 positive.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

**10. Portfolio Recommendation?**
Favor cyclicals/value exposure given cyclicals leadership (Materials, Industrials, Financials) and broad sector breadth; favor names showing clear ABOVE TREND continuation such as INTC (1W: +23.82% | 1M: +30.01%) ABOVE TREND, CAT (1W: +10.24% | 1M: +11.74%) ABOVE TREND, CRH (1W: +12.67% | 1M: +13.36%) ABOVE TREND. Reduce exposure to structurally weak Tech names exhibiting sustained BELOW TREND (ADBE (1W: -7.23% | 1M: -17.67%) BELOW TREND, NOW (1W: -18.63% | 1M: -28.22%) BELOW TREND). Style: Value/Cyclical over Growth.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?**
BULLISH: INTC (1W: +23.82% | 1M: +30.01%) ABOVE TREND, LRCX (1W: +20.70% | 1M: +20.46%) ABOVE TREND, UNH (1W: +9.76% | 1M: +6.69%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: ADBE (1W: -7.23% | 1M: -17.67%) BELOW TREND, NOW (1W: -18.63% | 1M: -28.22%) BELOW TREND, PSX (1W: -9.62% | 1M: -6.05%) BELOW TREND.

**12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?**
BULLISH: Materials (Materials: 9/11 positive) and Industrials (Industrials: 12/15 positive) — momentum in CRH and ETN. BEARISH: Energy (Energy: 3/10 positive) and Communication (Communication: 4/10 positive) — watch XOM (1W: -5.09% | 1M: +0.61%) CORRECTION for sentiment-price divergence.

**13. Key Levels & Triggers?**
Watch NVDA (1W: +6.34% | 1M: +1.40%) ABOVE TREND for continuation above recent monthly pivot to confirm tech participation. Monitor AAPL (1W: +1.78% | 1M: -0.13%) RECOVERY — needs sustained 1W follow-through to confirm trend flip. JPM (1W: +5.72% | 1M: +8.32%) ABOVE TREND — a move above recent highs would confirm financials extension.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

**14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?**
UNH (+60): UnitedHealth (1W: +9.76% | 1M: +6.69%) ABOVE TREND — sentiment and price confirming. LLY (+60): Eli Lilly (1W: +0.42% | 1M: -6.04%) RECOVERY — bullish headlines but price only partially confirming. XOM (+60): Exxon (1W: -5.09% | 1M: +0.61%) CORRECTION — bullish headlines diverging from near-term price action. MSFT (+50): Microsoft (1W: -0.69% | 1M: -8.40%) BELOW TREND — bullish news yet price remains BELOW TREND (watch for follow-through).

**15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?**
PSX (-60): Phillips 66 (1W: -9.62% | 1M: -6.05%) BELOW TREND — sentiment and price confirming risk. BA (-45): Boeing (1W: +4.52% | 1M: +1.65%) ABOVE TREND — negative headlines but price still ABOVE TREND (divergence). HON (-50): Honeywell (not in detailed list) flagged bearish — sector-level implications for Industrials to monitor.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

RISK-ON, Value/Cyclical style favored given 9/11 sectors positive and cyclicals leading. INTC (1W: +23.82% | 1M: +30.01%) ABOVE TREND, LRCX (1W: +20.70% | 1M: +20.46%) ABOVE TREND and AMZN (1W: +13.64% | 1M: +12.10%) ABOVE TREND are showing clear relative strength. Key risk: leadership narrowly concentrated in Tech (4/5 top performers) and MAJOR divergence across large caps (AAPL, META, V, MA, LLY) — monitor sentiment-price mismatches (e.g., XOM, MSFT).
